brief:
A Palestinian man fainted after Israeli forces detained him and kept him handcuffed for several hours in Masafer Yatta, the occupied West Bank, according to Middle East Eye. Video footage documented the incident showing the man losing consciousness while restrained.

The detention occurred in Masafer Yatta, a South Hebron Hills area where Palestinian communities face ongoing pressure from Israeli military operations and settlement expansion.
dek: Palestinian man faints after being detained and handcuffed for hours by Israeli forces A video shows a Palestinian man who fainted after being detained and kept handcuffed for hours by Israeli forces in Masafer Yatta, in the occupied West Bank.
title: Palestinian man collapses after hours of Israeli detention in handcuffs
